novelty_claim: Project-specific synthesis; no claim of global novelty or profitable edge

proposals.name: Selling loses its effect
proposals.mechanism: Temporary selling concession followed by declining marginal price impact, recovering liquidity and pressure decay.
proposals.incremental_feature: Change in conditional price response and liquidity recovery after comparable selling bursts.
kill_conditions: No incremental heldout information or executable economics
Effect lost under measured delay and costs
Price bounce or simple imbalance explains effect

proposals.name: The second reading of a release
proposals.mechanism: Potential delayed repricing of verified forward economic changes beyond headline surprise and initial reaction.
proposals.incremental_feature: Source-linked, comparable-period and accounting-basis reconciliation of forward economics.
kill_conditions: Unreliable extraction or unsupported numerical adjustments
No improvement over guidance surprise and initial reaction
Prospective effect lost after inference and execution delay
proposals.special_requirement: Prospective unseen releases with pinned model/prompt; historical LLM memory is a contamination risk.

proposals.name: Closing demand that is not being absorbed
proposals.decision_clock: Scheduled regular close minus 300 seconds, after receipt of required messages
proposals.exit_clock: Scheduled regular close minus 120 seconds; continuous-market exit; no assumed auction fill
proposals.mechanism: Deadline-sensitive demand potentially outlasts arriving opposing liquidity.
proposals.incremental_feature: Demand persistence and acceleration relative to matching interest and liquidity response.
kill_conditions: Latest imbalance or indicative gap explains gains
Gains require auction print despite preclose exit
Delay and costs eliminate incremental economics

before_evaluation: Freeze exact universe, dates, event thresholds, primary comparison, costs and tuning budget
Acquire and validate required timestamped observations
Implement and verify a separate reviewed study through the actual entrypoint
Record every research attempt; account for selection and dependent samples
